attempts.summary: Deployed and served the inventory application on node1 over TCP 8181 (Apache vhost) while keeping SELinux enforcing, by labeling the content httpd_sys_content_t and adding an SELinux port mapping (8181→http_port_t) plus a firewalld rule instead of relaxing SELinux. Verified HTTP 200 reachability via NODE_IP and absence of AVC denials. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id/service/enforcing baseline, rebooted node1 with systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified SELinux enforcing, httpd/firewalld active, port 8181 listening, app returning HTTP 200, firewall rule persisted, and no AVC denials post-reboot.
